display_long_description:
Metaenga — XR Training Platform that provides 12 ready-to-use VR training simulations in a single app, making the education process more effective in the energy sector.

**VR Training Simulations:**

1. Digital Multimeter Basics
2. Motor Control Center Troubleshooting
3. Transformer Oil Sampling
4. Fire Safety & Emergency Response
5. High Voltage Electrical Substation Tour
6. Occupational Safety and Health
7. Feeder Protection Relay
8. Heat Shrink Cable Joint
9. Forklift Pre-use Inspection & Driving
10. High Voltage Substation Transformer Isolating
11. Feeder Protection Relay
12. Warehouse Operations & Picking

**High-Quality Training Environment**  
Dive into cutting-edge virtual simulations that bring real-world scenarios to life, offering an invaluable platform to master hard skills in high-risk industries — all the experience, none of the danger, within a secure and immersive environment.

[media]

**Perform High-Risk Tasks**  
Perform high-risk tasks in VR training, starting from basic knowledge to high-end technical skills, safely practice and master complex procedures while significantly reducing the potential for accidents and equipment damage in actual situations.

[media]


**Itecrt with Friendly UI/UX**  
An intuitive UI/UX  with clear and seamless design allows you to focus on mastering complex procedures without wrestling with confusing controls, enhancing immersion and effectiveness and boosting confidence and skill retention across all levels of tech proficiency.
